in_greek.name: Γοθαρδός
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the elements 'God' (θεός, theos) and 'strong' or 'powerful' (δύναμις, dynamis) or 'hard' (σκληρός, skleros).

in_latin.name: Gothardus
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the elements 'God' (deus) and 'strong' or 'hard' (ard).
